text.en: These Regulations may be cited as .the Finance Companies (Advertisements) Regulations. Interpretation

In these Regulations "advertisement" means any notification or intimation of financing business or lslainic financing business - [S 43/'006]

(a) published in any newspaper, journal or magazine or in the form of a brochure or in any other form;

(h) displayed on any hoarding, boarding, roof wall, paling, fence, frame, signboard, plate, cloth, bar, pillar. post, wire, casting or other erection or contrivance; or

(c) conveyed by means of films within the meaning of the Censorship of Filins and Public Entertainments Act (Chapter 69); "existing advertisement" means any advertisement which is in existence on the date of the coming into operation of these Regulations; "Minister" means the Minister responsible for finance.

(1) No advertisement shall be made without previously obtaining a perinit in writing from the Minister.

(2) An applicant for a permit shall -

(b) supply such particulars of the advertisement in respect of which a permit is sought and in such form as the Minister may require.

(3) The Minister may, in his discretion, grant a pennit for an advertiseinent. with or without attaching any condition or conditions thereto.

(4) The fee payable for a permit under this regulation shall be $1 00.
No permit for advertiseinent as provided in regulation 3 shall be issued for any business other than financing business or Islainic financing business as defined in the Act. Permit number
